hook: Did moving the seat of government wait for the republican constitution?

claims.text: Arquivo Nacional account; MJP French editions Seat ≠ regime

Arquivo Nacional dates the vice-regal seat’s Salvador→Rio transfer to 1763. MJP’s French constitutional editions prescribe monarchy in 1824 and republic in 1891. A colonial capital move and later regime provisions are different events; neither establishes popular consent or freedom from slavery.
Did the colonial seat transfer wait for the republican constitution? No: the seat transfer precedes both later constitutional witnesses
